infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: PawMitra needs camera access to capture photos of injured animals for reporting incidents.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: PawMitra needs photo library access to select images for incident reports and pet profiles.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: PawMitra needs your location to find nearby incidents and volunteers.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: PawMitra needs your location to alert you about nearby animal emergencies even when the app is in the background.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: PawMitra needs microphone access to allow you to use speech-to-text for reporting incidents and chatting with the AI assistant.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow PawMitra to access your camera to capture photos of animals in distress.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow PawMitra to use your location to find nearby incidents and volunteers.
